notes: this is a statement of the routes by which al-Saduq had the book of Ibrahim b. Hashim: no saying follows, so rule 4 does not settle whether these are groups of one report
the joint «جميعا عن إبراهيم بن هاشم» makes Sa'd b. Abd Allah and Abd Allah b. Ja'far converge on Ibrahim; each group repeats the name, since the text does not write a shared tail
the Saduq's own «رويته» is the compiler and is added by the tool
